name: Bezel-Set Labradorite Ring
shortDescription: An oval labradorite with a blue-green flash, set in recycled 14k gold fill.
description: Each labradorite is cut and chosen by hand, so the flash sits a little differently on every stone. The bezel is recycled 14k gold fill, formed and burnished at the bench. The band is comfort-fit and sized to order. Because it is made one at a time, expect two to three weeks before it ships. Comes in a small linen pouch with a care card.
